### 2. Your role

Investigate and interpret ground for the stated decision; identify preliminary/final reports and monitoring endpoint. Civil/structural designers own design; contractor owns methods, temporary works and supervision. Environmental assessment is a separate appointment.
Ground brief: Confirm footprints, loads, levels/cut-fill, excavation, prior logs, services, risks, access and reliance recipients; reconcile conflicting plans.

### 3. Scope by stage

Base stages only, from written instruction/input-access milestone to the selected deliverable. Later options require written instruction; agree interim reports and monitoring endpoint. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| G1 Brief / plan | Review design and prior tests for relevance; agree location/method/depth/refusal/lab schedule, groundwater, clearance, safe fieldwork, access and handback; reconcile counts/levels. Deliver plan, inputs and issues register. |
| G2 Field / laboratory | Scheduled locating/clearance, drilling/coring/pits, sampling and tests; competent supervision. Record locations/datum/precision, logs/photos, groundwater and incomplete/refusal points; traceable lab records and scheduled site handback. |
| G3 Interpretation / report | Factual results, ground model, limitations and selected footing/settlement, earthworks, excavation, groundwater, aggressivity, pavement and classification parameters; location plan and designer parameter schedule. Identify pending tests and further evidence. |
| G4 Concept / planning | Compare selected ground/foundation options and risk; nominated planning report and responses. Interim report has stated limits; approval not guaranteed. |
| G5 Design / tender support (option) | Review conditions and changed footprint/loads against coverage; supplementary work separately priced. Review parameter use; tender inputs, hold points and scheduled queries. Review is not design authorship. A later stage the client may commission. |
| G6 Construction / completion (option) | Scheduled founding/pile/excavation inspections, earthworks tests and monitoring reviews; changed-condition advice, test/issues register and scoped completion statement. Record missed/inaccessible work; agree instruments handover/decommissioning. A later stage the client may commission. |
| G7 Contractor advice / transfer (option) | Define contractor design review, further investigation, client, reliance and endpoint. Separate appointment and fee for novation/transfer. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 4. Allowances

Client completes the reconciled plan and quantities. Guaranteed work is separate from time permitting; return insufficiency and fee effects before issue.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobilisation | 2 mobilisations; allocate rigs/locators/excavators, hours/crew/permits/access/water/power | Boreholes / cores | 2 by location/method/depth; soil/rock metres, penetration/refusal and pavement thickness |
| Pits / exposures | 2 by location/dimensions/depth; method, target evidence and stopping criteria | In-situ / laboratory | 2 laboratory tests; attach counts by suite/sample, method/accreditation/turnaround and in-situ type/location/frequency; environmental suites separate |
| Groundwater option | 2 optional monitoring visits; schedule spot readings, wells/loggers, tests, duration, updates and protection/decommissioning owner | Reports / support | 2 reports; schedule draft/final/updates, review rounds, meetings/duration and RFI/planning hours |
| Construction option | 2 inspections; schedule hold points, tests/reviews, booking notice, missed work and completion record | Handback / waste | 2 repair areas; surface/temporary/permanent standard; schedule spoil/fluid quantities, classification/disposal records and maintenance owner |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Investigation plan and issues register reconciled to allowances; Foundation/bearing/settlement advice; structural engineer designs; Earthworks/subgrade/pavement/retaining parameters; civil/structural designer designs, no cut/fill balance; Buried tank/OSD/services/asset exposure; no integrity certification; civil capacity/structural adequacy; Locating/clearance before intrusive work; name isolation/potholing party; Acid sulfate soil assessment; define desktop/intrusive/management package from evidence; Reinstatement, spoil/fluid disposal; name repair, classification, transport and disposal owners.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Beyond-spot groundwater monitoring / hydrogeology / dewatering; define objective, duration and specialist; Defect/distress diagnosis; expert evidence separate, structural engineer designs remedy; G6 inspections/tests/scoped completion; contractor books, named others supervise/design temporary works; G7 novation/transfer; separate appointment and fee, never inferred from route.
Excluded: the party named does it: Occupied access, tenant liaison and permits (client access lead (name in R4)); Contamination, waste classification, remediation/validation and independent audit (separately appointed environmental consultant (name in R4), not yet engaged).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Agree Project geotechnical appointment (attached), precedence and express departures before instruction; commencing work does not accept competing supplier terms.
- Written authority before extra scope/allowance/fee/program changes; state reason, baseline and effect. Immediate safety action: notify and record minimum action/cost. Agree standby/cancellation and handback.
- Design sign-off sets the pricing baseline; normal agreed development remains included.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Monthly itemised invoices payable within 30 days; disclose deposits/report withholding/licence suspension departures.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23; answers go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Client supplies inputs/access; report gaps. Manage agreed work/subcontractors without blanket service waiver. Disclose caps/time bars/indemnities/transfer/IP departures; agree notice/cure, safe handback, records and disputes.
- Dated PDFs, logs/lab certificates and editable data/registers; agree project use/reliance, confidentiality, sample retention/evidence preservation, instrument ownership and handover. State storage cost before disposal.

### 7. Evaluation

Evaluated price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Check coverage, competence, insurance and departures first. Normalise quantities, labs, monitoring, restoration and options; lowest price need not win.

R2 Deliverables list: Plan, logs/location/photos, labs, ground model/parameters, interim/final/monitoring reports and completion records: purpose, recipient, editable formats, dates, rounds, limits/reliance and pending tests.
R3 Hourly rates: Role/equipment and extra metre/hole/test/well/visit rates; minimum hire, travel, standby/cancellation, expedited lab/storage/restoration, ceilings and escalation. Expose markups.
R4 Team: Name lead, field supervisor, reviewer, environmental specialist, labs/subcontractors, competence and availability. Allocate clearance, sampling, design, disposal, reinstatement and handover; QA ISO or equivalent.
R5 Experience: Two or three comparable investigations with referees: actual ground/excavation, existing/live constraints, scale, decision, role and outcome.
R6 Departures: List scope/agreement departures, alternatives and fee/time effect, or nil. Include conflicting levels, counts/depths, reliance/environmental scope; authorised assumptions need quantity, decision owner/date.
R7 Program: Input/plan approval, mobilisation, field/lab, preliminary/final report and monitoring endpoint dates; optional construction coverage, booking notice, dependencies/start/pause and interim report limits.
R8 Insurance and compliance: Client-selected PI $5 million (client selected) and PL $20 million (client selected). Current PI/PL/workers compensation as applicable, claim/aggregate limits, exclusions, continuity and competence/registration. Agree client-selected insurance limits before issue.
R9 Reimbursables: Labs/plant/locator, permits, water/skips/disposal/restoration, travel, instruments/storage: included/allowance/rate, payer, quantity, markup/GST and approval. No R1 duplication; identify client-direct work.
